images.title: A calendar block in letters
images.purpose: Shows why the four dates of a 2 by 2 calendar block are a, a + 1, a + 7 and a + 8.
images.composition: One large 2 by 2 grid in the centre, two small arrows, and the sum below.
images.exact_structure: One 2 by 2 grid of four large square cells, white fill, dark outline. Top row: a, a + 1. Bottom row: a + 7, a + 8. The a cell is filled pale reddish purple #CC79A7. Above the top row, a short teal #0072B2 arrow pointing right labelled + 1. To the left of the grid, a short amber #E69F00 arrow pointing down labelled + 7. Below the grid, centred: 4a + 16 in reddish purple #CC79A7. Nothing else is drawn. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, which is large and centred; no scenery, no people, no other text.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Right is one more, below is seven more, so the block adds to 4a + 16.
images.description: Shows why the four dates of a 2 by 2 calendar block are a, a + 1, a + 7 and a + 8.
images.context: Picture for the 2 by 2 calendar block trick.
images.teaching_notes: Sum 36 gives 4a = 20, a = 5: the block is 5, 6, 12, 13.

image_decisions.why: The grid shows at once why moving right adds 1 and moving down adds 7.
